title: VALUE #( FOR … ) does not compile in APPEND LINES OF / inline DATA( )
symptom: Syntax error on APPEND LINES OF VALUE #( FOR … ) TO failed-entity, or DATA(x) = VALUE #( FOR … ). (Exact SAP message text not recorded — add it at the next occurrence.)
rootCause: # needs a typed target or a typed expression inside; the source position of APPEND LINES OF and an inline declaration provide neither, and FOR does not either.

solutions.label: Declare first or APPEND VALUE per row
solutions.body: DATA lt_x LIKE lt_src. lt_x = VALUE #( FOR … ). — or LOOP + APPEND VALUE #( … ) TO <typed>.

prevention: Frequent in RAP handlers filling failed-/reported- tables.
